name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data science/AI, Amplify Analytix for analytics) targeting financial services with AI-first customer intelligence solutions. Their methodology centers on predictive analytics, hyper-personalization engines, and real-time CDP activation for banking and insurance. Delivery model combines consulting with proprietary AI/ML tooling for next-best-action and customer lifetime value optimization. Thought leadership themes consistently revolve around GenAI applications in financial services CX, data-driven segmentation, and operationalizing customer insights at scale.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta occupies a unique niche as a dual SAP-Qualtrics specialist, embedding experience management directly into SAP transactional workflows via SAP BTP. Their methodology bridges operational data (O-data) with experience data (X-data) within enterprise SAP environments, targeting DACH manufacturing, financial services, and energy sectors. Their AI approach focuses on AI agents operating within SAP workflows to automate insight-to-action loops. Delivery model combines SAP consulting depth with Qualtrics implementation expertise, creating sticky enterprise engagements. Thought leadership consistently positions them at the intersection of ERP modernization and CX transformation.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics is the dominant Qualtrics partner in the GCC region, specializing in government and public sector citizen experience transformation. Their methodology centers on CX maturity frameworks tailored to Gulf state national transformation programs (Vision 2030, UAE digital government). AI approach emphasizes Qualtrics-native AI capabilities applied to citizen feedback analysis and service design. Delivery model combines strategic CX consulting with deep Qualtrics technical implementation for large-scale government programs. Thought leadership themes focus on public sector CX benchmarking, Arabic-language experience design, and digital government service optimization.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages the global research giant's scale to deliver CX measurement, benchmarking, and analytics services with Medallia as a core technology partner. Their methodology is research-centric, emphasizing statistically rigorous CX measurement, loyalty driver analysis, and experience ROI quantification. AI approach focuses on advanced analytics, NLP-driven text analysis, and predictive modeling applied to large-scale survey and behavioral datasets. Delivery model combines managed research services with Medallia platform implementation and optimization. Thought leadership themes consistently address CX economics, consumer trend analysis, and industry-specific experience benchmarks.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont is a US-based Qualtrics specialist partner focused on enterprise experience management program design and optimization, with particular strength in banking and financial services. Their methodology emphasizes CX program architecture, experience orchestration, and closed-loop action management. AI approach centers on Qualtrics-native AI capabilities including AI agents for automated insight delivery and intelligent workflow triggers. Delivery model combines strategic CX consulting with deep Qualtrics technical implementation and managed services. Thought leadership consistently addresses practical Qualtrics platform optimization, AI agent deployment patterns, and financial services CX use cases.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK/EU-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner historically focused on enterprise experience management consulting across financial services and public sector. Their methodology has emphasized Qualtrics program design, survey optimization, and CX analytics. However, the prolonged absence of new content makes it difficult to assess current AI stance or evolving delivery model. The extended quiet period raises questions about strategic repositioning, resource constraints, or potential business changes.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap is a Spain/LATAM-based CX and EX consulting firm with a platform-agnostic, methodology-driven approach to experience transformation. Their methodology emphasizes customer journey mapping, employee experience design, and organizational change management as integrated disciplines. AI stance remains relatively conservative compared to tech-forward competitors, with greater emphasis on human-centered design and strategic consulting. Delivery model is pure consulting with strong advisory capabilities across financial services, telecom, and retail in Spanish-speaking markets. Thought leadership themes consistently address the intersection of employee and customer experience, cultural transformation, and journey-based experience redesign.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo is an Iberoamerican CX consultancy with Qualtrics partnership and operations spanning 15+ Spanish-speaking markets. Their methodology combines CX strategy consulting with VoC program design, digital experience optimization, and NPS/CX metric frameworks. AI approach leverages Qualtrics-native capabilities for text analytics and automated insights within VoC programs. Delivery model bridges strategic CX advisory with Qualtrics implementation across banking, telecom, and retail sectors in Latin America and Spain. Thought leadership themes focus on CX maturity models, digital experience transformation, and Voice of Customer program best practices for Spanish-speaking enterprise markets.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant is a global digital transformation firm with a Connected Experiences Studio that addresses CX within a broader AI engineering and digital product development framework. Their methodology integrates CX design within large-scale technology transformation programs, emphasizing AI-native experience architectures. AI approach is enterprise-grade, positioning generative AI, AI engineering, and AI-powered experience design as core delivery capabilities. Delivery model is large-scale systems integration and digital transformation with CX as one dimension of multi-studio engagements. Thought leadership heavily emphasizes AI-first transformation narratives, with CX-specific content subordinated to broader corporate AI and digital innovation messaging.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.
